citations.locator: United Church of Canada, member profile
citations.excerpt: The United Church of Canada came into being in 1925, bringing together the Congregational, Methodist and most Presbyterian (71 percent) churches in Canada.

facts.value: Formed in 1925 by the Congregational, Methodist and most Presbyterian churches in Canada. It remains the largest non-Roman Catholic communion in Canada. The Canadian Evangelical United Brethren joined in 1968.

citations.excerpt: The new church began as, and remains, the largest non-Roman communion in Canada.
In 1968, the Canada Conference of the Evangelical United Brethren Church joined the church.
